name: governed-autonomy-substrate
description: Governed Autonomy Substrate is a modular Substrate-based framework for building governed autonomous systems. It bundles runtime pallets, node configs, Helm charts, tests, and docs to support cluster sandboxing, CI workflows, and real-world deployments with reproducible infrastructure and developer tooling.

paragraphs: A cryptographic authorization barrier for AI agents: no signed artifact, no action. Every action must carry a short-lived, single-use, Ed25519-signed Governance Authorization Artifact (GAA) that matches an audited, hash-chained log entry and the current policy.

Despite the repository name, this project currently implements a Python governance service and worker; it does not contain Polkadot/Substrate runtime pallets. OPA/Rego is used for pull-request risk scoring, while runtime action authorization is enforced by the Python policy engine.

requirements.text: Configure ENTRAREDIRECTURI to enable the server-side Authorization Code + PKCE flow at /auth/login; the callback validates state, nonce, tenant, ID-token signature and claims before setting an HttpOnly session cookie.

With DATABASEURL, PostgresOIDCSessionRepository persists the login state and session hash while PostgresRateLimiter enforces shared, fail-closed windows across Helm replicas; apply 003hasessionsratelimit.sql through the migration controller.
